text:
sasha: quick async standup — API gateway / routing / auth / rate limits

sasha: what I did yesterday: merged the canary routing policy change (traffic split 10% -> 90%) and added header-based route matching for X-Region. pushed a tiny config tweak to reduce cold-starts.

sasha: blockers: integration tests for per-route rate limits are flakey — seeing intermittent 429s in CI when header-based routing is enabled. need eyes on whether the rate-limiter respects routed-backends correctly.

mike: ack, I'll take a look at the PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/492) later this morning. can you drop a failing CI log snippet?

sasha: pasted the failing part below: 
```
2026-03-02T09:08:12Z ERROR gateway rate_limiter.go:87 request_id=bb8 route=mobile X-Region=eu-west 429 limit=100/1s
2026-03-02T09:08:12Z DEBUG router router.go:242 picked backend=token-mapper-v2
```

tara: I fixed token propagation in token-mapper yesterday (PR #501). verified locally that auth header flows through when using the new header matcher. if the gateway is picking the older backend for some requests that could explain the mismatch.

pratik: monitoring note: we saw a spike of 429s from our mobile clients between 09:05-09:10 UTC — it's almost entirely from EU region. rate metrics: mobile_route: 95th=18r/s, bursts hitting 160. current policy is `rate: 20/s, burst: 100` which explains the enforcement.

pratik: suggestion: temporarily increase `burst` for the `mobile` route to 200 and add a short-term auto-throttle window to smooth the spike. example config: 
```yaml
routes:
  - name: mobile
    match: header:X-Client-Type == mobile
    rate_limit:
      rate: 20/s
      burst: 200
      window_sec: 30
```

jen: +1 to increasing burst for mobile while we investigate root cause. also we should add a test that simulates header-based routing + rate limit enforcement so CI fails loudly on regressions. happy to pair on that test. :thumbsup:

mike: I'll review the rate-limiter logic today and try to repro the CI flake. if token-mapper-v1 is still in the backend pool we should evict it from canary hosts. tara, can you confirm deployment status for token-mapper?

tara: token-mapper-v2 is running on canary and staging, but there were a couple of old pods in prod that didn't get drained due to a taint race — draining now. will post an update when done.

sasha: thanks. action items: (1) mike reviews gateway PR (#492) and rate-limiter tests; (2) pratik increases mobile burst to 200 temporarily and adds a dashboard alert for sustained 429 rate; (3) tara finishes draining old token-mapper pods; (4) jen and mike add CI test for header-routing + rate-limiter.

sasha: anyone blocking on approvals?

mike: I'll approve the gateway PR if tests pass. targeting EOD.

tara: done draining old pods — prod now only has v2.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy completed for gateway v2 -> commit 0a1b2c at 2026-03-02T09:12:03Z :white_check_mark:

pratik: updated the mobile route in staging with burst=200, pushing to prod in 10m. will monitor 5m/1h error rates.

jen: ping @mike for review when ready, happy to help with CI test scaffolding.

sasha: great progress, thanks all. we'll reconvene async tomorrow or in ops if the alert fires. :rocket:
